extracted.intended_audience: prospective students applying to Riverside City College (first-time, transfer, returning, international, dual-enrollment, veteran)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and requirements for applying and enrolling at Riverside City College, including eligibility, account setup, submission confirmation, and post‑submission steps (welcome email, student ID).

rubrics_metrics.name: Home college selection
rubrics_metrics.description: By submitting the RCC admission application, you will be selecting Riverside City College as your HOME COLLEGE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be sure to apply for the college where you wish to receive services such as financial aid and counseling. Once your application has been processed, you will be eligible to enroll in classes at Moreno Valley College and Norco College in addition to Riverside City College, so you do not need to submit a separate application for each college.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — Who can apply?
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists categories of persons eligible to apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible applicants include: High school graduate or successfully passed CA High School Proficiency or GED exam; Non-high school graduate, 18 years or older; Non-high school graduate with Certificate of Completion; High school students who qualify for concurrent enrollment; International student (Additional Admission Steps Required).

rubrics_metrics.name: How to apply — OpenCCC account and online application
rubrics_metrics.description: Create or login to your OpenCCC account and complete an online admission application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Immediately after submitting your application you will receive an email confirmation that your application has been received. If you experience any difficulties logging into OpenCCC, you may need to use the Recover Account tool or contact OpenCCC Technical Support for assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-submission welcome email and student ID
rubrics_metrics.description: You will receive a welcome email within one business day providing your RCCD student ID number and RCCD email address.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make sure to check your junk/spam folder for the welcome email.

rubrics_metrics.name: International applicants — additional admission steps
rubrics_metrics.description: International student applicants have additional admission steps required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page flags international students separately with the note 'Additional Admission Steps Required' — prospective international applicants should expect extra documentation/processes beyond the standard online application (contact admissions for details).
